exposure: Gestational age (moderately preterm vs. late preterm)
cohort: 275 women with live diamniotic moderately and late preterm twin deliveries at 32(+0) -36(+6) weeks of gestation
finding: In moderately and late preterm twin deliveries, planned mode of delivery (trial of labor vs. planned cesarean section) did not affect neonatal outcomes, but mothers in the planned CS group had higher rates of puerperal infection and surgical complications.
mod_finding: Planned mode of delivery did not affect neonatal outcomes.
